items.stem: Which of the following best describes the unit rate in the ratio 18 miles to 3 hours? Show or explain your work.
A store sells 5 pencils for $2.50. What is the unit price per pencil?
Select all the statements that correctly describe properties of unit rates. Show or explain your work.
choices: A unit rate compares a quantity to one unit of another quantity.
Unit rates can be used to compare prices of items with different quantities.
Unit rates always result in a whole number.
Unit rates help us understand how one quantity changes in relation to a single unit of another quantity.

items.stem: A runner completes 9 laps in 3 minutes. Explain how to find the unit rate in laps per minute. Show or explain your work.
